in_sanskrit.name: क्षितिज्
in_sanskrit.meaning: क्षेत्र ज्ञानी, क्षेत्र का ज्ञाता, क्षेत्र पालन का कारक

in_tamil.name: க்ஷீடிஜ்
in_tamil.meaning: கோட்டையில் உரையாள், கோட்டையில் வழியில்லையில்லையோ, கோட்டையில் அமைப்பாளர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: He who knows the land, the one who is not in the land but rules it, the one who protects the land

in_telugu.name: క్෷ీద్జ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who knows the land, the landlord, the owner of the land

in_marathi.name: Kshitij
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Foundation or beginning
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshitij हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'kshiti', meaning 'earth', Kshitij is the name of the god Indra's son who is believed to be the first man on earth. This name signifies the foundation or beginning of something new. In Hindu mythology, Kshitij is also considered as the lord of the underworld and the ruler of the dead. This name is rich in cultural and spiritual significance.
